create_VideoDecoderWrapper: create a VideoDecoderWrapper instance to decode a video file with torchcodec or decord backend
build_VideoDecoderWrapper_cuda: build a VideoDecoderWrapper with CUDA device for GPU-accelerated video decoding
test_VideoDecoderWrapper_len: test the VideoDecoderWrapper __len__ method to get total frame count
run_VideoDecoderWrapper_get_frames_at: run VideoDecoderWrapper get_frames_at method to retrieve frames at specified indices
run_VideoDecoderWrapper_get_frames_as_te: run VideoDecoderWrapper get_frames_as_tensor method to get frames as a pinned torch tensor
